scope: Unmodified original Default, Current, SetSpeed and RegisterPack bodies execute against 99 resource packs and the complete AnimationList. Whole controller, mask and ordered registration callouts compared. Default includes metadata absence and zero packs; current includes all pool kinds and rejected tails; speed includes all pool boundaries, signed zero, subnormal, max finite, nonfinite and bounds assertion. Skeleton initialization and pack finalization are explicit callout services in this oracle; actual controller/skeleton ownership is pending. Deliberately gapped pack full-range fallback faults in the original diagnostic metadata lookup and is excluded from valid default-playback cases.
